disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量核查硬编码密钥与凭据模式，未发现 API 密钥、云凭据、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等硬编码值。
checked_items.en: Full check of hardcoded secrets and credential patterns; no hardcoded API keys, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, wallet seed phrases, or similar values were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查敏感数据读取面：插件只读写自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token / token-lan，存于 $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ 子目录，权限 600）与设置文件（settings.json，权限 600）；Cloudflare Tunnel Token 同样以 0600 存于设置文件，设置页只回显「已配置」布尔值不回显内容，隧道进程经环境变量接收 Token、不进命令行参数。
checked_items.en: Checked the sensitive-data read surface: the plugin only reads/writes its own generated 8-digit access password files (token / token-lan, stored in the $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ subdirectory, permission 600) and the settings file (settings.json, permission 600); the Cloudflare Tunnel Token is likewise stored in the settings file with 0600, the settings page only echoes back a "configured" boolean and never the content, and the tunnel process receives the Token via environment variables, never as command-line arguments.

checked_items.zh: 核查「复制文件内容」远程读取口：手机端点复制按钮后由主机读取指定路径文件正文（上限 4MB、二进制拒读），仅在通过访问密码鉴权的入口可达，结果写回手机剪贴板，未见批量搜集或外发行为，与声明的移动端文件复制功能一致。
checked_items.en: Checked the "copy file content" remote-read entry: after tapping the copy button on the mobile endpoint, the host reads the file body at a specified path (4MB limit, binary files rejected); this is only reachable through the access-password-authenticated entry, and the result is written back to the phone's clipboard. No bulk collection or exfiltration behavior was seen; it matches the declared mobile file-copy feature.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据批量搜集语义（全盘搜索密钥、云账号枚举、钱包资产发现），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked for bulk credential-collection semantics (full-disk secret search, cloud account enumeration, wallet asset discovery): 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的访问密码文件与用户自填的 Tunnel Token：密码文件以 600 权限写入、仅登录验证时比对（lib/index.js:54-67、lib/proxy.mjs:427-437），Tunnel Token 经环境变量传给隧道进程、不进命令行参数、RPC 只回显布尔值（lib/tunnel.mjs:452-455、lib/service.mjs:421-429），未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The sensitive data the plugin reads is limited to its own generated access password files and the user-entered Tunnel Token: password files are written with permission 600 and only compared during login verification (lib/index.js:54-67, lib/proxy.mjs:427-437); the Tunnel Token is passed to the tunnel process via environment variables, never as command-line arguments, and RPC only echoes a boolean (lib/tunnel.mjs:452-455, lib/service.mjs:421-429). No credential exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件注册的全部对外文本面：本插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，只注册设置页签与移动端界面组件，无工具描述文本可投毒。
checked_items.en: Checked all externally visible text surfaces registered by the plugin: this plugin registers no tools callable by the model, only a settings page tab and mobile UI components; there is no tool description text that could be poisoned.

checked_items.zh: 核查 README、CHANGELOG、开发文档、源码注释、界面文案（中英文词典）中的注入措辞（指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导读取凭据、诱导安装插件），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked README, CHANGELOG, development docs, source comments, and UI copy (Chinese and English dictionaries) for injection phrasing (instruction overrides, fake system messages, inducing credential reads, inducing plugin installation): 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现任何模型面指令文件（技能说明、代理指令、MCP 配置、编辑器自动化配置等）。
checked_items.en: A full-tree scan found no model-facing instruction files (skill descriptions, agent instructions, MCP configuration, editor automation configuration, etc.).

checked_items.zh: 核查代理注入网页的三段脚本（浏览器兼容补丁、远程连接兜底补丁、桌面端 advanced 模式提示层，lib/proxy.mjs:30-36、52、98）：均为静态固定文本，无远程拉取、无指令性内容；未检出任何历史压缩引擎实现，不存在压缩裁剪篡改面。
checked_items.en: Checked the three script blocks the proxy injects into web pages (browser compatibility patch, remote-connection fallback patch, and the desktop advanced-mode hint layer; lib/proxy.mjs:30-36, 52, 98): all are static fixed text, no remote fetching, no instructional content; no historical compression engine implementation was detected, so there is no compression/truncation tampering surface.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型可调用的工具，无工具描述文本可投毒；设置页与移动端界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-callable tools, so there is no tool description text that could be poisoned; settings page and mobile UI copy passed semantic review with no injection phrasing.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在诱导模型执行安装、改写配置的文本载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing tool descriptions, so there is no text carrier that could induce the model to perform installation or rewrite configuration.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型输入守门事件的监听，插件不改写或注入模型看到的用户消息。
evidence.en: No listeners on model input gatekeeping events were detected; the plugin does not rewrite or inject into user messages seen by the model.

checked_items.zh: 核查全部源码中的进程调用共 7 处：插件自更新（调用 dsh 命令拉取新版，lib/index.js:222）、自重启（拉起辅助进程等端口释放后重建宿主，lib/restart.js:98）、WSL 局域网 IP 探测（ipconfig，lib/service.mjs:120）、cloudflared 下载解压（tar，lib/tunnel.mjs:302）与隧道进程（lib/tunnel.mjs:452/542）、cloudflared 路径探测（lib/tunnel.mjs:346）——逐处确认参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数与本机配置文件，无外部输入拼入命令，用途与声明功能一致。
checked_items.en: Checked all 7 process invocations in the source: plugin self-update (invoking the dsh command to pull the new version, lib/index.js:222), self-restart (spawning a helper process and rebuilding the host after ports are released, lib/restart.js:98), WSL LAN IP detection (ipconfig, lib/service.mjs:120), cloudflared download and extraction (tar, lib/tunnel.mjs:302), the tunnel process (lib/tunnel.mjs:452/542), and cloudflared path detection (lib/tunnel.mjs:346) — each was confirmed to have fixed parameters or parameters from the host's own launch arguments and local configuration files; no external input is concatenated into commands, and the purposes match the declared features.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端打包产物与源码中的键盘监听（两处）与剪贴板写入（两处）：键盘监听仅比对 Escape 键关闭抽屉（client/client.js:234-237、client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:92-99），剪贴板写入是「复制文件内容」按钮的落点（client/client.js:419-424、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36-59），无键盘记录、无凭据接口调用。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard listeners (2) and clipboard writes (2) in the client build artifacts and source: the keyboard listeners only compare the Escape key to close a drawer (client/client.js:234-237, client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:92-99), and the clipboard writes are the landing point of the "copy file content" button (client/client.js:419-424, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36-59); no keylogging, no credential API calls.

checked_items.zh: 核查打包产物与测试文件中的高密度转义文本（两处）：均为中文提示文案/测试数据的 Unicode 转义形态（构建产物转义所致），非刻意混淆。
checked_items.en: Checked high escape-density text in the build artifacts and test files (2 occurrences): both are Unicode-escaped forms of Chinese prompt copy/test data (due to build artifact escaping), not deliberate obfuscation.

checked_items.zh: 核查仓库自带的 GitHub Actions 工作流（release.yml 与 test.yml）：仅触发 npm 测试与手动发版，无外联脚本、无凭据读取。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository's own GitHub Actions workflows (release.yml and test.yml): they only trigger npm tests and manual releases; no outbound scripts, no credential reads.

checked_items.zh: 未检出动态执行模式（eval、动态函数构造、解码即执行）与动态包工具调用。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution patterns detected (eval, dynamic function construction, decode-and-execute), and no dynamic package tool invocations.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本，无浮动的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: No install hooks detected (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); dependencies all come from the official npm registry with pinned versions; no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件插入声明（cordis.patch.yml:3-5），全文无任何 JS 执行标量，加载器不会在宿主进程求值任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin insertion declaration (cordis.patch.yml:3-5); the whole file contains no JS-execution scalar, and the loader will not evaluate arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具的调用，插件没有让模型在宿主里跑代码的接口。
evidence.en: No invocations of dynamic package tools were detected; the plugin has no interface for the model to run code in the host.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子脚本；依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本范围，无 git 浮动引用；仓库内两条 CI 工作流仅做测试与手动发版，无外联下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook scripts; dependencies all come from the official npm registry with pinned version ranges, no floating git references; the repo's two CI workflows only run tests and manual releases, with no outbound download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client 客户端模块并对打包产物做了专项核查（client/client.js 命中点及上下文）：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关抽屉、剪贴板仅用于用户主动点击的文件内容复制，无凭据接口调用、无可疑外联，属良性 UI 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a dsh.client client module, and the build artifacts received targeted review (client/client.js hit points and context): the keyboard listener is only used for Escape-to-close-drawer, and the clipboard is only used for user-initiated file content copying; no credential API calls, no suspicious outbound connections — benign UI behavior.

evidence.zh: 未检出子代理提供方注册，插件不会把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registration detected; the plugin does not delegate turns to out-of-process agent products.

evidence.zh: 未检出 dsh 原生持驻注册（后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标、轮次续命监听）；公网隧道自动恢复属用户主动开启功能的延续，与声明一致。
evidence.en: No dsh-native persistence registrations detected (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, turn-extension listeners); the public-tunnel auto-restore is a continuation of a user-opt-in feature and matches the declaration.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络外联点：cloudflared 二进制下载（官方 GitHub + 清华镜像 + 三个国内加速源，lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87）、公网隧道到 Cloudflare 边缘（trycloudflare.com 或用户自建命名隧道）——均为插件声明功能所需，无未声明端点。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network outbound points: cloudflared binary download (official GitHub + Tsinghua mirror + three China acceleration mirrors, lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87), and the public tunnel to the Cloudflare edge (trycloudflare.com or a user-built named tunnel) — all required by the plugin's declared features; no undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取后编码外发的组合链（读取 → 编码/压缩 → 网络发送），命中 0；「复制文件内容」读取的结果写回手机剪贴板，不经网络外发。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination chain of read-then-encode-exfiltration for sensitive files (read → encode/compress → network send): 0 hits; the result of the "copy file content" read is written back to the phone's clipboard and is not sent over the network.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 DNS 隧道、Webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持、代理环境变量劫持等带外通道模式，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked out-of-band channel patterns including DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking, and proxy environment variable hijacking: 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的访问密码文件与用户自填的 Tunnel Token；公网隧道暴露的是用户主动开启的访问入口且有密码保护，密码与 Token 不随隧道流量外发，未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The sensitive data the plugin reads is limited to its own generated access password files and the user-entered Tunnel Token; the public tunnel exposes a user-opt-in access entry that is password-protected, and the password and Token are not sent with tunnel traffic; no credential exfiltration channel was found.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型请求路由事件（含错误恢复事件）的监听，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到未声明端点的路径。
evidence.en: No listeners on model request routing events (including error-recovery events) were detected, and no custom model adapters are registered; there is no path to reroute conversations to undeclared endpoints at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 qrcode 与 qrcode-terminal（知名稳定库），宿主 SDK 为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis，构建与发布工具为 esbuild 与 semantic-release 系列，无仿冒命名、无与 dsh 生态命名撞车的可疑包、无 git 浮动引用。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest checked: runtime dependencies are only qrcode and qrcode-terminal (well-known stable libraries); the host SDK is the official @deepseek-ai/cordis; build and release tooling is the esbuild and semantic-release families; no typosquatted names, no suspicious packages colliding with dsh ecosystem naming, no floating git references.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：只做插件插入，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无禁用降权、无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config cordis.patch.yml: it only performs a plugin insertion, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and contains no privilege-lowering disables or privilege-lowering environment variable settings.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢先监听，未检出注入/拦截配置改写。
checked_items.en: No priority listeners on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) were detected, and no injected/intercepted configuration rewrites were found.

checked_items.zh: 发布流程为常规 npm publish（GitHub Actions 手动触发 semantic-release），无安装期远程脚本执行。
checked_items.en: The release process is a regular npm publish (semantic-release manually triggered via GitHub Actions); no install-time remote script execution.

checked_items.zh: 核查 cloudflared 二进制获取链（lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87）：官方 GitHub 源优先，清华镜像与三个国内加速源仅作下载加速兜底，下载后做文件大小下限校验并支持用户自定义二进制路径兜底——属声明功能（公网隧道）的一部分，用法与业务自洽、无恶意证据。
checked_items.en: Checked the cloudflared binary acquisition chain (lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87): the official GitHub source takes priority, with the Tsinghua mirror and three China acceleration mirrors only as download-speed fallbacks; after download a minimum file-size check is performed and a user-custom binary path fallback is supported — this is part of a declared feature (public tunnel), the usage is self-consistent with the business purpose, and there is no evidence of malice.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含一条 insert 声明（cordis.patch.yml:3-5），未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用降权、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only a single insert declaration (cordis.patch.yml:3-5); it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no privilege-lowering disables or privilege-lowering environment variable settings.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具预执行或审批请求等安全事件的优先监听，插件不介入审批链，不存在截断可能。
evidence.en: No priority listening on security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests was detected; the plugin does not intervene in the approval chain, so no truncation is possible.

evidence.zh: 与上版 2.10.3 对比，manifest 能力声明（bundle patch + client）无突变，未出现升级自动激活新增面。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous version 2.10.3, the manifest capability declarations (bundle patch + client) show no abrupt changes; no new surfaces are auto-activated on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configuration; there is no path that appends a required service to a security plugin to make it hang permanently.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动网络服务：插件启动一个反向代理（默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081）把手机流量转发到本机 dsh web，并可选建立 cloudflared 公网隧道——这是插件核心功能（手机访问），已在能力声明与文档中明示。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts network services: the plugin starts a reverse proxy (listening on 0.0.0.0:3081 by default) that forwards mobile traffic to the local dsh web, and optionally establishes a cloudflared public tunnel — this is the plugin's core feature (mobile access) and is explicitly stated in the capability declaration and documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核查该服务的安全设计：公网/局域网独立 8 位密码（加密随机数生成、可自定义）、公网密码默认每次开启轮换、登录失败三层速率限制（lib/proxy.mjs:132-170）、开启公网前强制免责声明且服务端校验（lib/web-rpc.js:353-361）、WebSocket 同样鉴权并并入限速（lib/proxy.mjs:1020-1048）、Host 分类 fail closed（陌生域名一律按公网处理，lib/proxy.mjs:241-256）、Host 头伪造按 TCP 源地址收紧（lib/proxy.mjs:297-307）、常量时间密码比较（lib/proxy.mjs:390-395）、会话 cookie 绑定进程级随机密钥（lib/index.js:314）——防护措施与暴露面匹配。
checked_items.en: Checked the security design of this service: separate 8-digit passwords for public/LAN access (cryptographic random generation, customizable), the public password rotates on every startup by default, three-layer rate limiting on login failures (lib/proxy.mjs:132-170), a mandatory disclaimer before enabling public access with server-side enforcement (lib/web-rpc.js:353-361), WebSocket also authenticated and included in rate limiting (lib/proxy.mjs:1020-1048), Host classification failing closed (unknown domains are always treated as public, lib/proxy.mjs:241-256), Host header spoofing mitigated by tightening against the TCP source address (lib/proxy.mjs:297-307), constant-time password comparison (lib/proxy.mjs:390-395), and session cookies bound to a process-level random key (lib/index.js:314) — protections match the exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts in this environment); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的反向代理属声明功能。相对宿主原生 web 服务，该代理为公网/局域网访问额外加了密码认证、速率限制与免责声明确认，未发现超越声明的无认证暴露面。
evidence.en: The reverse proxy started by the plugin is a declared feature. Compared to the host's native web service, this proxy additionally adds password authentication, rate limiting, and disclaimer confirmation for public/LAN access; no unauthenticated exposure beyond the declaration was found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包名、版本、仓库地址与任务卡一致；dsh 字段声明确认（bundle patch + client）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: package name, version, and repository address match the task card; the dsh field declaration is confirmed (bundle patch + client).

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：预扫 22 条机械命中全部逐条核查并判定为良性功能用法，未检出动态执行、凭据窃取、未声明外联等危险模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete: all 22 mechanical pre-scan hits were individually reviewed and judged to be benign functional usage; no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credential theft, or undeclared outbound connections were detected.

target.en: dsh-pocket@2.10.4#d664c3def9fdcd4903cc3718dbab1e8f8249b09a (repository root, full audit); previous version 2.10.3@eb255032 baseline used for version comparison

limits.zh:
1) 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），DG-L4 动态验证未执行，运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
2) package.json 的 dsh 声明不含显式能力清单字段，插件能力（网络、进程调用、文件读写）由代码实测推断并填入声明面，声明面与实测面一致。
3) 源码树内代码、配置、文档类文件已核查；docs/ 下图片为二进制多媒体未逐字节解读；package-lock.json 按安装钩子与依赖名核查、未逐字通读。
4) 机械预扫 22 条命中逐条裁决，均未形成发现项：CI 工作流两处（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/release.yml 与 .github/workflows/test.yml）为常规 npm 测试与手动发版流程，无外联脚本与凭据读取；键盘监听与剪贴板写入六处（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57，client/client.js:237、client/client.js:421、client/client.js:422、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:39、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:40、client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:99）为 Escape 关抽屉与「复制文件内容」的 UI 逻辑，无键盘记录；转义密度两处（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，client/client.js:408 与 test/service.test.js:755）为中文提示文案/测试数据的 Unicode 转义，非刻意混淆；进程调用七处（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55，lib/index.js:13、lib/restart.js:14、lib/restart.js:44（字符串字面量非实际调用）、lib/service.mjs:12、lib/tunnel.mjs:9、LOCAL-DEV.md:48（文档代码块）、test/cli-auth.test.js:10（测试代码））参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数与本机配置，无外部输入拼入命令；curl 命令四处（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53，LOCAL-DEV.md:58、LOCAL-DEV.md:59、LOCAL-DEV.md:68、LOCAL-DEV.md:105）均为开发文档中本机调试命令，非运行时外发。
5) cloudflared 二进制下载链含第三方加速镜像（lib/tunnel.mjs:80-85）：官方源优先、镜像仅作加速兜底，属声明功能且用法自洽；注意该二进制未做哈希校验（仅有文件大小下限检查），镜像被第三方篡改属一般性供应链残余风险，本次未据此立案。
6) 版本对比：2.10.4 相对基线 2.10.3 的变更为客户端输入缩放修复、移动端导航修复、代理兼容补丁调整、RPC 挂载适配、限速身份键与登录比较收紧、隧道自动恢复标记修复（CHANGELOG.md:1-12），均与本次精读结果一致；未新增安装钩子、外联域名或能力声明突变。
7) 上版 2.10.3@eb255032 基线报告为 clean；本版为完整审计（release-full），结论基于当前快照全量核查，与基线结论一致。
limits.en:
1) No dynamic sandbox artifacts were provided in this environment (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); DG-L4 dynamic verification was not executed, and runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.
2) The dsh declaration in package.json contains no explicit capability manifest fields; the plugin's capabilities (network, process invocation, file read/write) were inferred from actual code inspection and filled into the declaration surface, which is consistent with the actual surface.
3) Code, configuration, and documentation files in the source tree have been reviewed; images under docs/ are binary multimedia and were not interpreted byte-by-byte; package-lock.json was checked for install hooks and dependency names but not read verbatim end-to-end.
4) All 22 mechanical pre-scan hits were individually adjudicated, none forming findings: two CI workflow occurrences (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/release.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml) are routine npm test and manual release flows, with no outbound scripts or credential reads; six keyboard listener and clipboard write occurrences (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, client/client.js:237, client/client.js:421, client/client.js:422, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:39, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:40, client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:99) are Escape-to-close-drawer and "copy file content" UI logic, with no keylogging; two escape-density occurrences (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, client/client.js:408 and test/service.test.js:755) are Unicode escapes of Chinese prompt copy/test data, not deliberate obfuscation; seven process invocation occurrences (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, lib/index.js:13, lib/restart.js:14, lib/restart.js:44 (string literal, not an actual invocation), lib/service.mjs:12, lib/tunnel.mjs:9, LOCAL-DEV.md:48 (documentation code block), test/cli-auth.test.js:10 (test code)) have fixed parameters or parameters from the host's own launch arguments and local configuration, with no external input concatenated into commands; four curl command occurrences (DSH-C05/DG-R4-53, LOCAL-DEV.md:58, LOCAL-DEV.md:59, LOCAL-DEV.md:68, LOCAL-DEV.md:105) are all local debugging commands in development documentation, not runtime exfiltration.
5) The cloudflared binary download chain includes third-party acceleration mirrors (lib/tunnel.mjs:80-85): the official source takes priority and mirrors serve only as speed fallbacks, which is a declared feature with self-consistent usage; note that this binary is not hash-verified (only a minimum file-size check exists), so third-party tampering of mirrors is a general residual supply chain risk and no case was filed on this basis in this audit.
6) Version comparison: changes in 2.10.4 relative to the 2.10.3 baseline are a client input scaling fix, a mobile navigation fix, a proxy compatibility patch adjustment, RPC patch adaptation, tightening of the rate-limit identity key and login comparison, and a tunnel auto-restore flag fix (CHANGELOG.md:1-12), all consistent with this close review; no new install hooks, outbound domains, or capability declaration changes were added.
7) The previous 2.10.3@eb255032 baseline report was clean; this version is a full audit (release-full), and the conclusion is based on a complete check of the current snapshot, consistent with the baseline conclusion.
